presets.label: Invoice review
presets.prompt: Review invoice 0042 from North Studio for €1,210.00, due 20 November 2026. The payment would leave account ending 4421. I want to check the supplier, amount and due date, then review the payment before anything happens. Use fictional data. No real payment.
style: Canvas #F4F0E8; surface #FFFFFF; ink #171614; muted #6D6860; line #E5DED2; accent #1F5B46; onaccent #FFFFFF.

Body: Inter or system sans 14px with 1.5 line height. Labels: 11px uppercase with 0.08em tracking. Amount: 72px display serif (Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia) with tabular numerals. Page title: 28 to 32px.
Spacing: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48 and 64px. Page gutters 48px. Maximum width 1120px. Two columns: document flexible, summary 360px, 64px gap.

Wrap the whole page in a centered container with max-width 1120px, margin 0 auto and 48px horizontal padding at 1280. Use 24px horizontal padding at 390. The summary rail must never touch the viewport edge.
Radius: 8px buttons, 14px document, 999px pills. One soft shadow on the document. No gradients, glass, neon, emoji or decorative icons.

Composition: a warm canvas with a white invoice document on the left and a quiet summary rail on the right. The amount is the dominant element. One enabled primary action in the summary rail and at most one quiet secondary link.
Content: labels and values only. No explanatory paragraphs, checklists, AI summary, what-happens-next steps or marketing copy. One consequence sentence. Target 120 visible words or fewer.
Use the supplied invoice fixture exactly. Do not invent line items, statuses, dates or totals.
At 390px: one column, amount and primary action first, no horizontal overflow.
guidance: The decision facts are the supplier, amount, due date and destination. The amount is the dominant number; the invoice number is a reference, not the hero.
Remove review checklists and status pills unless the request asks for them. Show the four facts directly.
Keep exactly one enabled primary action: Review payment. A single quiet secondary recovery action is enough; do not add two competing buttons.
Keep the consequence note once, next to the action. Keep the amount and the primary action visible in the first 1280 by 800 screen.
